verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at API maturity and change management: new features ship behind feature flags with alpha features off by default, Composition Revisions manage changes to Compositions, and XRDs define schemas for composite resources. Nothing documents explicit API versioning (such as v1/v1beta1 stability guarantees) or any deprecation policy. Missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme and stability levels, a published deprecation policy with timelines, and independent corroboration.
